dialogue.soulless.sensei.first.1: Another one with a sword on their back. Standing at my gate, %1$s, and not even a bow.
dialogue.soulless.sensei.first.2: Fine. Out with it. Why are you here?
dialogue.soulless.sensei.greet: You again. The tea's getting cold. Talk.
dialogue.soulless.sensei.who: An old man who teaches swords to obey the hand. My name's no use to you. Teacher will do.
tooltip.soulless.broken_katana: The sensei's ancestral blade, broken many generations ago
message.soulless.astral_forgot: You feel you have forgotten something
message.soulless.oath_breach: The oath: the blade will not touch the innocent
dialogue.soulless.kitsune.wake.1: *A huge white fox opens one eye. The violet seals around her flare and slowly fade.*
dialogue.soulless.kitsune.wake.2: A human... No one has come here in a long time. There are no guests here - only prisoners. What do you want?
dialogue.soulless.kitsune.blade.1: This blade... I remember it. The hand that held it, and the night it cracked.
dialogue.soulless.kitsune.blade.2: Innocent blood broke it. After that night I stopped coming to that family. Not that I go anywhere - I never leave this place.
dialogue.soulless.kitsune.why: It can be mended. But first tell me: why do you want it?
dialogue.soulless.kitsune.why_unknown: You don't know. Hm. Centuries of pretty lies, and you honestly don't know. I like that.
dialogue.soulless.kitsune.why_power: The one who held it before you wanted that too. Strength without a purpose has already broken this steel once.
dialogue.soulless.kitsune.why_protect: He said the same. Word for word. I don't need words - I need an oath.
dialogue.soulless.kitsune.oath.1: I'll reforge it. But first, swear.
dialogue.soulless.kitsune.oath.2: This blade will not touch a single innocent soul - not a beast, not a person. Only monsters. Only those who came to kill.
dialogue.soulless.kitsune.oath.3: And the only blood it takes is yours. That is not a sin. That is its price.
dialogue.soulless.kitsune.refuse_confirm: Think. Refuse, and this blade will never be yours. Never.
dialogue.soulless.kitsune.sworn: Good. Hold it tight. And wake up, while sleep still lets you go.
dialogue.soulless.kitsune.refused.2: Then I'll tell you what I wouldn't tell one who swore. I don't sleep here by choice. The Wailing Reaper holds me.
dialogue.soulless.kitsune.refused.3: He is in the Nether, in the soul sand valley, at the Soul Altar. Go to him, if you have the nerve.
dialogue.soulless.kitsune.opt.blade: The sensei says you once enchanted this blade. It's broken.
dialogue.soulless.kitsune.opt.why_unknow: I don't know. The sensei asked me.
dialogue.soulless.kitsune.opt.why_protec: To protect those who can't protect themselves.
tooltip.soulless.training_katana: The sensei's wooden blade: the same moves, no magic
tooltip.soulless.training_katana.lore: Its grip is worn smooth by many students' hands
message.soulless.parry_unknown: You don't know how to parry yet: the sensei teaches it
message.soulless.training_no_ritual: That is not done with a training blade
message.soulless.cleanse_done: The mountains are quieter. Return to the sensei.
message.soulless.cleanse_reset: You hurt an innocent. The count starts over.
message.soulless.katana_mended: The Legendary Katana is whole again
advancement.soulless.sensei_student.desc: Hold out in the sensei's sparring and learn to parry
book.soulless.family_scroll.1:
The Family History

In days long gone our ancestor bore a blade enchanted by Kitsune herself.

The blade took one price only - its bearer's blood - and turned it into strength.
book.soulless.family_scroll.2:
But one day anger blinded him. He raised the blade against an innocent - and the steel broke in his hands.

Since that night Kitsune does not come to the dreams of our family.
book.soulless.family_scroll.3:
The eldest of the family keeps the broken blade. Only she who once enchanted it can mend it.

The old ones say the white foxes know the way to her.
book.soulless.family_scroll.4:
Let whoever bears this blade one day remember:

the blood of an innocent breaks steel.

One's own blood is only the price.
dialogue.soulless.sensei.offer.1: Learn... Everyone wants to learn until the first rap on the knuckles. Show me what you can do.
dialogue.soulless.sensei.offer.2: Here. It's wood, but the bruises are real. When you're ready, stand across from me.
dialogue.soulless.sensei.spar.1: Stand across from me. I strike - you turn the blow aside just as it comes (RMB). Not before, not after.
dialogue.soulless.sensei.spar.2: Five clean parries and your hand will remember. Miss one and it hurts. Not for long.
dialogue.soulless.sensei.spar.start: Watch my shoulder, not the sword. A glint - and I strike.
dialogue.soulless.sensei.spar.miss2: Watching the sword again. The shoulder!
dialogue.soulless.sensei.spar.weapon: Blade in hand. Wave your fists in the village.
dialogue.soulless.sensei.spar.pause: Catch your breath. Tell me when to go on.
dialogue.soulless.sensei.spar.abandon: A break, then. Come back and we go on.
dialogue.soulless.sensei.spar.done: Enough. It's in your hands now. It stays there, even if you get yourself killed somewhere.
dialogue.soulless.sensei.cleanse.1: At night things come down from the mountains. Kill ten of them. With that stick.
dialogue.soulless.sensei.cleanse.2: And listen: no beast, no villager comes to harm by your hand. Touch one and you start over. That's not a whim.
dialogue.soulless.sensei.cleanse_wip: Ten. And not one innocent. Go.
dialogue.soulless.sensei.shrine.1: I saw. You cut clean and leave the blameless alone. Few can.
dialogue.soulless.sensei.shrine.2: There's something I... find it hard to speak of. In my family's abandoned shrine there is a scroll. Read it yourself.
dialogue.soulless.sensei.shrine.3: Here's a map. Bring me the scroll.
dialogue.soulless.sensei.no_shrine: The shrine is far. My memory can't find it any more. Look in the forests and the taiga.
dialogue.soulless.sensei.shrine_wip: The cross on the map. A forest. A scroll. What are you waiting for?
dialogue.soulless.sensei.confession.2: Yes. My ancestor struck an innocent, and the blade broke in his hands. My family has kept quiet about it for centuries. So did I.
dialogue.soulless.sensei.confession.3: Since that night Kitsune doesn't come to our dreams. She won't come to me. To you - she might.
dialogue.soulless.sensei.blade.1: This blade has lain with us longer than this house has stood. Steel isn't meant for a chest.
dialogue.soulless.sensei.blade.3: Only Kitsune can reforge it. If she accepts you.
dialogue.soulless.sensei.fox.1: Through the white foxes. They live up north, in the snow. They like sweet berries - start there.
dialogue.soulless.sensei.fox.2: Once a fox is yours, sleep under a roof beside her, with the blade on you. Sleep under the open sky is shallow - you won't reach Kitsune.
dialogue.soulless.sensei.after: You have the blade. The rest is in your sleep.
dialogue.soulless.kitsune.mend.1: You again. And broken steel again.
dialogue.soulless.kitsune.mend.2: No matter. Steel tires, the oath doesn't. Give it here.
dialogue.soulless.kitsune.mended: Here. And look after it - I have less strength than it seems.
message.soulless.harakiri_unknown: You don't know yet what this blade does with R. Ask the sensei
message.soulless.renegade_won: The Renegade is beaten. The sensei should hear of this.
message.soulless.renegade_lost: You wake in a cold sweat. He will come again when you sleep.
advancement.soulless.renegade_beaten.des: Defeat the Renegade in the dark astral
advancement.soulless.harakiri_learnt.des: Learn from the sensei what price the blade takes
dialogue.soulless.renegade.call: There you are. The one the old man gave the blade to.
dialogue.soulless.renegade.intro1: Don't recognise me? Of course not. The old man doesn't talk about me.
dialogue.soulless.renegade.intro2: I stood in that same dojo. Held that same stick. Only nothing worked for me, and he looked at me as if I wasn't there.
dialogue.soulless.renegade.intro3: And you he gave the blade. Just like that. Give it to me - or I take it.
dialogue.soulless.renegade.win: That's all? The blade won't save you.
dialogue.soulless.renegade.defeat1: No... No, it can't be. I trained. All those years...
dialogue.soulless.renegade.defeat2: This isn't over. And you know what? The old man will never tell you you're worth anything either. You'll remember me then.
dialogue.soulless.sensei.forged.1: She accepted you, then... I wasn't wrong about you.
dialogue.soulless.sensei.forged.2: Don't celebrate too loudly. Not everyone will like that blade being back in the world.
dialogue.soulless.sensei.opt.renegade: I met a swordsman in black. He knows you.
dialogue.soulless.sensei.renegade.2: He was my student. Tried harder than anyone, did worse than anyone. And I was too hard on him. One day he left - and found teachers no one names aloud.
dialogue.soulless.sensei.renegade.3: He didn't break you. Then it's time for the last lesson.
dialogue.soulless.sensei.harakiri.1: Kitsune's blade takes one payment - the blood of whoever holds it.
dialogue.soulless.sensei.harakiri.2: Kneel, turn the blade on yourself and drive it in (R). It hurts: three hearts. It can kill.
dialogue.soulless.sensei.harakiri.3: But Kitsune sees what you give and lends you her strength for a while: a faster blade, and blows find you less.
dialogue.soulless.sensei.harakiri.4: Don't do it out of boredom. And never out of pride. He would have.

tooltip.soulless.quest.spar: Sparring: parry 5 of the sensei's blows
tooltip.soulless.quest.ask: Ask the sensei what comes next

tooltip.soulless.quest.scroll_found: Bring the scroll to the sensei
dialogue.soulless.renegade.seize1: There. At last... What? It burns... It burns! It won't have me!
dialogue.soulless.renegade.seize2: Fine. Fine. I'll come to you in your sleep, %1$s. Every night. Until it's mine.
dialogue.soulless.renegade.dream_call: Asleep? I told you I'd come.
dialogue.soulless.renegade.again1: You again. Again that blade, obeying you and not me.
dialogue.soulless.renegade.again2: The old man can't help you here. No one can.
